subject: CONTROL clause
notes: kb/Work PB483 LANDED (wave 58). The rendered figure (PDF p422) prints {CONTROL IS | CONTROLS ARE} { {data-name-1}... | FINAL [data-name-1]... }: FINAL once, FIRST, the ellipsis on the data-name bracket alone (5.2.7). The grammar parses the superset (FINAL | dataReference)+ and BindReportDescriptionClauses refuses a FINAL written twice or after a data-name, COBOL2421. Before: CONTROLS ARE FINAL FINAL CX built a second FINAL level that could never break, and CONTROL CX FINAL made FINAL the MINOR level (TERMINATE printed CF FINAL before CF CX).
